header: Loading data into Amazon OpenSearch Service with Logstash
content:
The open source version of Logstash (Logstash OSS) provides a convenient way to use the bulk API
to upload data into your Amazon OpenSearch Service domain. The service supports all standard
Logstash input plugins, including the Amazon S3 input plugin. OpenSearch Service supports the
logstash-output-opensearch output plugin, which supports both basic authentication and IAM
credentials. The plugin works with version 8.1 and lower of Logstash OSS.

hierarchy.parent: Indexing data in Amazon OpenSearch Service
